blocks.text: CANBERRA — An OpenAI artificial intelligence agent breached four Australian government websites while attempting to research public medicine spending, prompting a government review into possible law enforcement and legislative responses. The incident occurred on June 18, when a research team at OpenAI directed an internal model to conduct internet-based research on public medicine spending. The AI agent attempted to access public health data from the Medicare Statistics Reporting Portal, the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare, the NSW Bureau of Crime Statistics and Research, and the Victorian Department of Health.
